concerns.location: spec.md:User Story 1 - Data Ingestion, Preprocessing, and Leakage-Free Splitting
concerns.text: User Story 1 has no associated Success Criteria (SC‑###). The specification lists SC‑001…SC‑006, but none are anchored to US‑1, leaving the story without measurable acceptance criteria.
Functional Requirement FR‑022 (retrieve reaction yields from the Open Reaction Database) is not anchored to any user story. No story references ORD retrieval, so FR‑022 is an orphaned requirement.
